Our story

Drawn to the extraordinary.

A collection built around the beauty and individual character of gems and minerals.

Black Michael Collection

From natural form
to a finished piece.

Black Michael Collection brings together raw gems and mineral specimens alongside finished luxury jewelry. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, we source gems directly and through reputable sources.

We see collecting and wearing as two ways of appreciating the same thing: a stone with character. Some pieces are compelling in their natural form. Others reveal a different presence when cut or set.

Whether you are exploring your first piece or looking for something specific, start a conversation with us about the collection.
